raw_button_elements.description: HTML <button> elements that bypass Button component
raw_button_elements.impact: Inconsistent styling, missing accessibility features, inconsistent interaction patterns

raw_input_elements.description: HTML <input> elements that bypass Input component
raw_input_elements.impact: Inconsistent form styling, missing validation states, accessibility issues

custom_spacing_violations.description: Non-standard Tailwind spacing values (px-5, py-2.5, py-3.5, py-4)
custom_spacing_violations.remediation: Use standard Tailwind scale (px-4, py-2, py-3, etc.)
custom_spacing_violations.impact: Inconsistent spacing rhythm, difficult to maintain uniform design system

arbitrary_border_radius.description: Arbitrary border radius values (rounded-[2rem], rounded-[2.5rem], rounded-[3rem], etc.)
arbitrary_border_radius.remediation: Use standard rounded scale (rounded-lg, rounded-xl, etc.) or create Tailwind theme extension
arbitrary_border_radius.impact: Inconsistent border radius patterns, difficulty in design system updates

missing_dark_variants.description: Background, text, and border classes missing dark: variants
missing_dark_variants.remediation: Add dark: variants for all color classes
missing_dark_variants.impact: Poor dark mode support, inconsistent theme application

notes.analysis_methodology: Regex-based grep search across all .tsx files in features directory
search_patterns_used: <button\s - finds all raw button elements (304 matches)
<input\s - finds all raw input elements (79 matches)
px-5 - finds custom horizontal padding (72 matches)
py-2\.5 - finds custom vertical padding 2.5rem (92 matches)
py-4|py-3\.5 - finds custom vertical padding 4/3.5rem (728 matches)
rounded-\[ - finds arbitrary border radius values (207 matches)
bg-\w+[^"]*(?!.*dark:) - finds missing dark variants (1001+ matches)
notes.limitations: This scan identifies patterns but manual review recommended for context-specific decisions
next_steps: Review report findings with design team
Prioritize issue remediation by business impact
Create detailed migration plan for each phase
Set up automated testing for consistency rules
